item.title: Why Long-Term Survivorship Demands Longitudinal Monitoring - HealthcareNOWradio.com
item.description: By Erin Dickman DNP RN OCN - Cancer survivorship rates continue to grow, with the 5-year survival rate now reaching 70% across cancers. This is, of course, a source of hope for patients and families as they move forward after treatment.

item.title: Friday Five: Priorities Driving Rural Health Transformation - HealthcareNOWradio.com
item.description: As states pursue Rural Health Transformation funding, five priorities keep rising to the top: telehealth, workforce stability, integrated behavioral health, stronger primary care, and the data systems needed for value‑based care. This week’s Friday Five breaks down what these trends mean for the future of rural health.

item.title: From Metrics to Meaning: Rethinking Value-Based Care Delivery - HealthcareNOWradio.com
item.description: On this episode of PopHealth Week, host Fred Goldstein and executive producer, Gregg Anthony Masters welcome Grace Terrell MD, MMM, Chief Medical Officer IKS Health, who discusses value based care (VBC) model transformation issues and opportunities to move beyond "box‑checking" to enabling better care (the triple aim, better care, better outcomes at lower per capita costs).

item.title: Affordability of GLP-1s Takes Next Step with BALANCE Model RFAs - HealthcareNOWradio.com
item.description: What’s new: State Medicaid agencies and Medicare Part D plan sponsors are now encouraged to apply to participate in the BALANCE (Better Approaches to Lifestyle and Nutrition for Comprehensive hEalth) Model, which will lower the cost and expand coverage of select GLP-1 medications for weight management in Medicare Part D and Medicaid.
